title: Engineering for AI-native companies
description: Context, harness, loop and graph engineering extend beyond software delivery into governed business execution.

layers.title: Agentic business lifecycle
layers.explanation: Humans define outcomes; the COO coordinates specialist agents and brings results back for review.

layers.title: Graph engineering
layers.details: COO · Goal plans · Workflow DAGs · State
layers.explanation: Connect the steps, owners and dependencies needed to complete work across business systems.

layers.title: Loop engineering
layers.explanation: Use execution evidence to check progress, handle exceptions and continue within policy and budgets.

layers.title: Harness engineering
layers.explanation: Give agents a controlled execution environment and access to the tools their role permits.

layers.title: Context engineering
layers.explanation: Ground work in company structure, shared information and the context of the current task.

layers.title: Model abstraction
layers.explanation: Connect model capabilities to the same operating context and governed execution system.

foundation.title: Flolah Company OS
foundation.note: *Physical AI is an evolving scope, dependent on compatible adapters, equipment and local safety controls. Integration and audit span the execution stack.
